purpose: Close Relay G04 by preventing any customer-facing capability, comparative, performance, savings, reliability or outcome claim that is not directly supported by observed evidence for the same task class and delivery configuration.

claim_classes.required_evidence: machine-observed successful execution on promised task class
deterministic repeated runs under locked acceptance criteria
exact-task request-equivalent benchmark against named alternative
real paid transaction evidence plus equivalent-output comparison
machine-observed elapsed-time records under equivalent conditions
observed repeated-run success/failure record; no extrapolation beyond sample
externally verifiable customer/payment/outcome record; internal, synthetic and dry-run records prohibited

publication_contract.publish_only_if: status == EVIDENCED AND every evidence record is readable, current, exact-task relevant and non-conflicting

current_external_claim_allowance: No performance, savings, superiority, paid-usage, revenue or customer-outcome claims may be added until corresponding evidence is recorded. Demand-research language may describe the problem and intended evaluation method without promising delivery or results.
truthfulness: Absence of evidence is reported as absence of evidence, never converted into an estimate or implied traction.
security_and_payment: This contract grants no payment authority and changes no signer or checkout controls.
